scope: Independent behavioral coverage of the public specifications. This is not Signal wire compatibility or an inherited formal proof. No upstream implementation or test body is included.

related_suites.coverage: Exact deterministic keys, ciphertexts and shared secrets; byte-by-byte ciphertext mutation and implicit rejection.

related_suites.scope: Complete inventories for protocol session/ratchet integration tests, chain-key unit tests and session-management regression/property tests. Group messaging, sealed sender, identity fingerprints and other unrelated APIs are outside this channel. Behavioral mappings are independent tests, not copied bodies or a claim of identical wire compatibility.
